cues.en: Hello everybody.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: My name is Alan Blomquist. I'm the engine and sort of the low level programmer at indie game developer, Tamara Corporation.
cues.zh: 我叫 Alan Blomquist。我是独立游戏开发商 Tamara Corporation 的引擎程序员兼底层程序员。

cues.en: And today I'm gonna do a quick demo of some of our internal tools and specifically focus on programming and debugging.
cues.zh: 今天我将简短演示一些我们的内部工具，重点关注编程和调试。

cues.en: We've been developing games and a lot of the tools that we used to make them for over a decade now. And at this point we're using our own programming language, compiler front end and back end, editor, debugger,
cues.zh: 我们开发游戏以及用于制作游戏的许多工具已经超过十年了。现在我们使用的是自己的编程语言、编译器前端和后端、编辑器、调试器、

cues.en: build system and game engine.
cues.zh: 构建系统和游戏引擎。

cues.en: I got really interested in working on stuff like this when I read
cues.zh: 我开始对这类工作产生浓厚兴趣，源于我读到过

cues.en: years and years ago, it must have been a blog post or something about this thing called Goal that they developed at Naughty Dog for some of their PS2 games and it was like a custom programming tool chain.
cues.zh: 很多年以前的一篇博客文章什么的，讲的是 Naughty Dog 为其 PS2 游戏开发的一种叫作 Goal 的东西，它就像是一个定制的编程工具链。

cues.en: And I remember reading about that and just thinking that this is obviously like the coolest thing that I've ever heard of. It didn't seem like something that you could even do.
cues.zh: 我记得当时读到这个时，就觉得这显然是我听过的最酷的事情。这甚至不像是一件能做到的事。

cues.en: So that really made an impression on me and kind of showed me my own lack of imagination at the time.
cues.zh: 所以那真的给我留下了深刻的印象，也让我看到了自己当时想象力的缺乏。

cues.en: But fast forward to four or five years ago now and I got a chance to work on something like that for our own company and it's kinda become like a passion project for me so I'm excited to show off some of the cool things that I think we've been able to come up with.
cues.zh: 但快进到四五年前，我得到了一个为我们自己的公司开发类似东西的机会，这对我来说有点像是变成了一个充满热情去做的项目，所以我很高兴能展示一些我认为我们已经能够实现的酷炫功能。

cues.en: For this demo I'm gonna use a port that I made of one of our games, Human Resource Machine, that wasn't originally created using these tools but I wanted to have a real finished game to use here and not just like a toy example.
cues.zh: 这个演示中我要用一个移植版，来自我们的一款游戏《人力资源机器》，它最初不是用这些工具做的，但我想用一个真正完成的游戏来演示，而不是玩具示例。

cues.en: Also, game happens to be a game about programming,
cues.zh: 而且这游戏恰好是关于编程的游戏，

cues.en: but this demo's about our development environment in general and so it would apply equally well to any of our games.
cues.zh: 但这个演示主要是关于我们的开发环境，所以同样适用于我们的任何游戏。

cues.en: I'm gonna start with just sort of the basic version of what a lot of the rest of this stuff is gonna be based on. This is the only non code part of the demo where I'm gonna show off my art skills and do a simple hot load of a data asset.
cues.zh: 我先从基础版本开始，后面很多东西都会基于这个。这是演示中唯一非代码的部分，我要展示一下我的美术功底，做一个简单的数据资产热加载。

cues.en: So if I bring up a texture from the game here and I make an edit and save it,
cues.zh: 比如我从游戏里调出一张纹理，修改并保存，

cues.en: then we can see that it shows up here in the game without having to stop and restart it. So that's a nice feature to have but now we're gonna build off that idea and see what else we can do.
cues.zh: 就能看到它直接在游戏里更新了，不用停止再重启。这是个不错的功能，但接下来我们要在此基础上看看还能做些什么。

cues.en: I'll open up our code editor here and we'll see if we can't do something a little more interesting.
cues.zh: 我打开代码编辑器，看看能不能做点更有意思的事。

cues.en: This is the code that's drawing these green boxes over on the left side here
cues.zh: 这是左边绘制这些绿色方块的代码

cues.en: And since we hot loaded data, it's only fair that we hot load code.
cues.zh: 既然我们热加载了数据，那热加载代码也是理所当然的。

cues.en: So if I make an edit here,
cues.zh: 如果我在这里做个修改，

cues.en: we can see that that gets hot loaded too.
cues.zh: 可以看到它也被热加载了。

cues.en: Our compiler is incremental and it builds native code pretty fast so we can compile on every keystroke
cues.zh: 我们的编译器是增量的，构建原生代码非常快，所以每次按键都能编译

cues.en: and there's almost no delay between me typing into the editor and the changes showing up in the game even in this kind of ridiculous 13,000 line source file.
cues.zh: 从我在编辑器里输入到游戏里显示变化几乎没有任何延迟，即使是在这个夸张的13000行源文件里也是如此。

cues.en: If I navigate over to the code that's drawing the floor here with these blue boxes,
cues.zh: 如果我把光标移到这里用蓝色方框绘制地板的代码上，

cues.en: we can see some debugging features.
cues.zh: 我们可以看到一些调试功能。

cues.en: If I set a breakpoint at the top of this function, you can see that the scene is kind of partially drawn in right now
cues.zh: 如果我在这个函数的头部设置一个断点，你可以看到现在场景只绘制了一部分，

cues.en: And then as I step through here,
cues.zh: 然后当我在这里单步执行时，

cues.en: I can see the different things that I'm drawing showing up on the screen as I go.
cues.zh: 随着我的操作，屏幕上会显示出我正在绘制的不同内容。

cues.en: Since this is our own debugger talking to our own game engine, we can kind of arrange to keep the screen alive while you step through code sort of like a graphics debugger. And that can come in handy sometimes when you're trying to figure out where some stray little thing on the screen is coming from.
cues.zh: 既然这是我们自己的调试器在跟我们自己的游戏引擎通信，我们就可以在单步调试代码时保持屏幕画面持续刷新，有点像图形调试器。当你试图弄清楚屏幕上某个莫名其妙的小东西是从哪来的时，这会非常管用。

cues.en: Another thing I can do while I'm stepping through my code here is actually do a step backwards.
cues.zh: 在我这里单步调试代码时，我能做的另一件事其实是进行反向单步。

cues.en: I can do backwards versions of the usual step in, step over, step out. And I can run backwards to my breakpoint and I can also run backwards to hardware data breakpoints.
cues.zh: 我可以执行常规的步入、步过、步出的反向版本。我可以反向运行到断点，也可以反向运行到硬件数据断点。

cues.en: And being able to debug backwards from an assert or a crash, especially with a data breakpoint is insanely helpful in being able to figure out and fix bugs.
cues.zh: 能够从断言或崩溃处进行反向调试，特别是配合数据断点使用时，对于排查和修复Bug简直有如神助。

cues.en: And one of the keys to making this as practically useful as possible is that this isn't a special mode that I launch the game into in order to do this kind of debugging.
cues.zh: 让这个功能尽可能实用的关键之一在于，这并不是为了进行这种调试而需要把游戏启动到的某种特殊模式。

cues.en: This is just the way it works all the time. So you always have this option available while you're working.
cues.zh: 这就是它一直以来的工作方式。所以你在工作时随时都可以使用这个功能。

cues.en: So I'll switch over to the game window now and we can look at our in game profiler.
cues.zh: 现在我切换到游戏窗口，我们可以看看游戏内的性能分析器。

cues.en: By default, the instrumentation for the profiler doesn't get compiled in but when I click enable here we do a full recompile
cues.zh: 默认情况下，分析器的插桩代码不会被编译进去，但当我点击这里的启用时，我们会对游戏代码进行完全重新编译，

cues.en: of the game code and now we're getting our call graph instrumentation.
cues.zh: 现在我们就能获取调用图插桩数据了。

cues.en: And it looks like there are some spikes happening on some of these frames so I'll pause this data collection so we can take a closer look.
cues.zh: 看起来其中一些帧出现了尖峰卡顿，所以我暂停数据收集以便仔细查看。

cues.en: If I look at the frame that got expensive here, there's this one function taking up most of the time
cues.zh: 如果我看一下这一帧变慢的原因，这里有一个函数占用了大部分时间，

cues.en: and normally in a profiler you can click on the name of the function and go see the source code and I can do that here
cues.zh: 通常在性能分析器中，你可以点击函数名去查看源码，我在这里也可以这样做。

cues.en: But since we can debug backwards, another thing that I can do is click on this timestamp up here
cues.zh: 但既然我们可以进行反向调试，我还可以做的另一件事是点击上面这个时间戳，

cues.en: and when I do that, I'm taken to the actual invocation of this function on this frame
cues.zh: 当我这样做时，我会直接跳转到这一帧中该函数的实际调用位置，

cues.en: and I can debug and see that
cues.zh: 然后我可以进行调试并发现，

cues.en: the reason that this took so long this time is that I got an unlucky random number.
cues.zh: 这次耗时这么久的原因是我抽中了一个倒霉的随机数。

cues.en: Now obviously this is a contrived example and this isn't a silver bullet for every possible kind of performance issue but it's a cool additional tool and it can be really useful for certain kinds of situations.
cues.zh: 当然，这只是一个人为设计的例子，它并不是解决所有性能问题的万灵药，但它是一个很酷的附加工具，在某些情况下真的非常有用。

cues.en: So once I resume this
cues.zh: 所以一旦我恢复运行，

cues.en: and get rid of this bad code here,
cues.zh: 并去掉这段有问题的代码，

cues.en: then the profile looks good and I can
cues.zh: 分析器的视图就正常了，我可以

cues.en: compile out the instrumentation code
cues.zh: 把插桩代码编译掉，

cues.en: and we can keep going.
cues.zh: 然后我们就可以继续了。

cues.en: So the profiler can tag function activations with these timestamps for debugging but that's also something that you can do yourself in code.
cues.zh: 因此，性能分析器可以用这些时间戳标记函数激活以便调试，这也是你可以在代码中亲自实现的功能。

cues.en: For example, a lot of the time if you create something at one point in a program and it needs to be cleaned up later, you tag it with some kind of debug information so you know where it came from.
cues.zh: 比如很多时候，你在程序里某个位置创建了东西，之后又需要清理它，就会给它打上某种调试信息标签，好知道它是从哪来的。

cues.en: So memory allocations or a thing like that where you'd normally tag those with like a file name and a line number or if you're lucky you can tag them with a call stack and it makes it easier to debug memory leaks and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 所以像内存分配这类东西，你通常会用一个文件名和行号给它们打标签，运气好的话还能用调用栈打标签，这样更容易调试内存泄漏之类的问题。

cues.en: So here in our programming language we have something like an intrinsic that when it gets evaluated at run time it gives you the current execution time stamp and you can use that to tag stuff with instead.
cues.zh: 所以在我们的编程语言里，有一种类似内建原语的东西，它在运行时求值时会给出当前执行时间戳，你可以改用这个来给东西打标签。

cues.en: So I'll break into the game here and I'm gonna look at the data for the boxes
cues.zh: 那我先切进游戏，来看看这些箱子的数据

cues.en: that I put on the conveyor belt to solve this level.
cues.zh: 这些是我为了通关这个关卡放到传送带上的箱子。

cues.en: So I can see that there are three of them here
cues.zh: 可以看到这里有三个

cues.en: and if I look at the middle one I threw on,
cues.zh: 如果我看看我扔上去的中间那个，

cues.en: here's the timestamp I associated with it and then I can use that to go back and
cues.zh: 这是我给它关联的时间戳，然后我可以用它回去

cues.en: look at the point in time when that box was actually thrown onto the conveyor.
cues.zh: 查看那个箱子实际被扔上传送带的那个时间点。

cues.en: And if I undo that I can go back and look at a different one
cues.zh: 如果我撤销这一步，就可以回去看另一个箱子

cues.en: and see what was going on when I threw that one on.
cues.zh: 看看我扔上那个箱子时发生了什么。

cues.en: So that's an example of the kind of thing that I might tag in this sort of game but in other games you might tag the creation of all your bad guys or remember the last time the player got hit or track the history of every door that you walked through or whatever else you can think of.
cues.zh: 这就是在这类游戏里我可能会打标签的一类例子；但在其他游戏里，你可以给所有敌人的创建打标签，或者记住玩家上次被击中的时间，或者追踪你走过的每扇门的历史，或者任何你能想到的东西。

cues.en: These timestamps are super cheap to generate and they're only 64 bits so you can use them to tag pretty much everything with what effectively is the entire state of the program.
cues.zh: 这些时间戳生成起来非常便宜，而且只有64位，所以你可以用它们给几乎所有东西打上标签，实际上就是程序的整个状态。

cues.en: And then you can go back later and inspect anything you need to if you wanna find out where something came from or why it didn't get cleaned up or whatever you wanna know.
cues.zh: 然后你可以之后回头检查任何你需要的东西，如果你想找出某个东西来自哪里，或者为什么它没有被清理掉，或者任何你想知道的事情。

cues.en: So finally, now we're gonna turn the determinism knob all the way up to 11.
cues.zh: 所以最后，现在我们要把确定性旋钮直接拉到11。

cues.en: So when I come in here and bring up our developer console in the game, we have a scrubber and some playback controls down here
cues.zh: 所以当我来到这里，在游戏中调出我们的开发者控制台时，我们这里有一个拖动条和一些播放控制。

cues.en: and this timeline has everything that I just did during this demo and I can use it to go back and sort of inspect any part of it that I'm interested in.
cues.zh: 这个时间线包含了我刚才在这个演示中所做的一切，我可以用它回去检查我感兴趣的任何部分。

cues.en: And this isn't like a video that we're looking at, this is the actual simulation and rendering of the game happening on demand.
cues.zh: 这不是我们在看一个视频，这是游戏按需进行的实际模拟和渲染。

cues.en: This all still works even though I did stuff during the demo like fully recompile the code for the profiler,
cues.zh: 这一切仍然有效，尽管我在演示期间做了一些事情，比如为分析器完全重新编译了代码，

cues.en: I edited the code for these boxes and I changed this texture
cues.zh: 我编辑了这些盒子的代码，我改变了这个纹理

cues.en: but I can still scrub back and forth through all those different changes.
cues.zh: 但我仍然可以在所有这些不同的更改之间来回拖动。

cues.en: I specifically wanted to try not to have one way streets in this functionality.
cues.zh: 我特别想尽量避免在这个功能中出现单行道。

cues.en: So using one feature doesn't rule out using a different one later on.
cues.zh: 所以使用一个功能并不排除以后使用另一个功能。

cues.en: So if I go back to before I changed the code for these boxes,
cues.zh: 所以如果我回到我更改这些盒子的代码之前，

cues.en: if I come in here and I debug this now, I can see that this is the original version of the code before I changed it.
cues.zh: 如果我来到这里现在调试这个，我可以看到这是在我更改之前的代码的原始版本。

cues.en: And that's because the editor is aware of this whole system and it always lets me work with the state of the code as it was at the time that I'm looking at.
cues.zh: 这是因为编辑器了解整个系统，它总是让我能处理我所查看的那个时间点的代码状态。

cues.en: I could also go back and profile code after the pact if I'm playing along and I see a weird hitch or something like that. I don't have to start thinking about how to reproduce it, I can just go back and see what it was.
cues.zh: 如果我在玩的时候看到奇怪的卡顿之类的，我也可以事后回去对代码做性能分析。我不用开始想怎么复现它，只要回去看看当时是什么情况。

cues.en: And the point of all this isn't that I'm just dying to go back and debug my stale code, the point is that the system as a whole is a coherent set of features that all work together.
cues.zh: 这一切的重点并不是我特别想回去调试旧代码，重点是整个系统是一套协同工作的连贯功能。

cues.en: So if you've worked with other determinism based replay systems,
cues.zh: 所以如果你用过其他基于确定性的回放系统，

cues.en: one of the issues that they tend to have is that they feel really fragile and you have to have constant vigilance that you don't do something that's gonna break the determinism.
cues.zh: 它们常见的问题之一是让人感觉很脆弱，你必须时刻警惕，别做出会破坏确定性的操作。

cues.en: But in our case, since we've created every level of this stack to support this,
cues.zh: 但在我们这里，因为这套技术栈的每一层都是为了支持这一点而构建的，

cues.en: we can super efficiently offload the determinism stuff to the development environment and essentially you can just write whatever code you want without having to spend any time thinking about whether or not you're breaking something.
cues.zh: 我们可以非常高效地把确定性相关的事情交给开发环境处理，基本上你想写什么代码就写什么代码，不用花时间考虑自己有没有破坏什么。

cues.en: The other cool thing about this is that we save a session file with this timeline every single time you run the game. And since this whole thing is integrated with our version control,
cues.zh: 另一件很酷的事是，每次你运行游戏，我们都会保存一个带有这条时间线的会话文件。而且因为整套东西和我们的版本控制集成在一起，

cues.en: the amount of data we actually need to save to be able to replay a timeline stably at any point into the future is really small.
cues.zh: 为了能在未来任意时间稳定回放一条时间线，我们实际需要保存的数据量非常小。

cues.en: And it's not just programmers who are generating these session files, it's everybody on the team and the files are portable.
cues.zh: 生成这些会话文件的不只是程序员，团队里每个人都会生成，而且这些文件是可移植的。

cues.en: So if you're a designer working on a level and something isn't working quite right when you try it in the game or you just randomly saw something weird happen and you want somebody to look into it, you can send your session to anyone else and they can play it back live and debug it. And this is all integrated with our build system so that it all just works even if you had local changes when you created the session
cues.zh: 所以如果你是个设计师，正在做某个关卡，在游戏里试的时候发现哪里不太对劲，或者你碰巧看到什么奇怪的现象，想让别人查一下，你可以把会话发给任何人，他们能实时回放并调试。而且这整个和我们的构建系统集成在一起，所以即使你创建会话时有本地改动，也能正常跑通。

cues.en: and the person playing it back is on a different revision and source control and they have their own local changes,
cues.zh: 而回放的人处在源代码管理的另一个版本上，并且他们自己也有本地改动，

cues.en: the system can get all the data it needs to play back the session and it doesn't touch any of my actual local files in the process so there isn't any risk of me losing work if something went wrong.
cues.zh: 系统仍能拿到回放会话所需的全部数据，而且整个过程不会碰我本地任何实际文件，所以就算出了什么问题，我也不会有丢失工作的风险。

cues.en: So I have a session here that I have prepared ahead of time
cues.zh: 我这里有一个提前准备好的会话

cues.en: and,
cues.zh: 然后，

cues.en: we can imagine that somebody sent this to me to look at because their game crashed.
cues.zh: 我们可以设想是有人把这个发给我看，因为他们的游戏崩溃了。

cues.en: So I'll load this up
cues.zh: 那我来加载一下

cues.en: and I'll run it to the end
cues.zh: 然后把它运行到结尾

cues.en: and sure enough they got an access violation here.
cues.zh: 果然，他们在这里遇到了访问违规。

cues.en: And you can see that the boss from human resource machine lives on our panic screen and he is not happy with me right now.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，Human Resource Machine 里的那个老板就住在我们的恐慌界面上，他现在对我很不满意。

cues.en: So one thing I can do is just sort of go back through this session and look at what happened.
cues.zh: 所以我能做的一件事就是回看这个会话，看看发生了什么。

cues.en: So it looks like somebody played through the level once,
cues.zh: 所以看起来有人通关了一次这个关卡，

cues.en: they went back and sort of optimized their solution,
cues.zh: 然后他们回过头来优化了一下自己的解法，

cues.en: played through it again,
cues.zh: 又重新玩了一遍，

cues.en: and then got this crash.
cues.zh: 接着就遇到了这个崩溃。

cues.en: So if I click on the top of the call stack here, I'm taken into the code editor
cues.zh: 所以如果我点击这里调用栈的顶部，就会进入代码编辑器

cues.en: and if I got an access violation on this line,
cues.zh: 如果我在这一行遇到了访问违规，

cues.en: that probably means that this pointer
cues.zh: 那通常意味着这个指针

cues.en: is null
cues.zh: 是空指针

cues.en: and I know that this is a parameter to this function so I'll do a reverse step out of the function
cues.zh: 而且我知道这是这个函数的参数，所以我将反向步出这个函数

cues.en: and here I am back before I called into it
cues.zh: 现在我又回到了调用它之前的状态

cues.en: and here we're passing the null pointer in
cues.zh: 这里我们正在把空指针传进去

cues.en: and I can see that that pointer is supposed to get set up in this if block
cues.zh: 我能看到这个指针本来应该在这个 if 块中初始化

cues.en: depending on if you're in normal play mode or playing on the phone.
cues.zh: 取决于你是在正常模式下玩还是在手机上玩。

cues.en: And if I look at the current value of this play mode variable,
cues.zh: 如果我查看这个播放模式变量的当前值，

cues.en: the debugger is saying that the value it has is not actually a valid member of the enumeration.
cues.zh: 调试器显示它的值实际上并不是枚举的有效成员。

cues.en: And if you look at the bit pattern here you might recognize that that's the floating point number one.
cues.zh: 如果你看一下这里的位模式，你可能会认出那是浮点数 1。

cues.en: So at this point you're thinking this looks like a memory stomp and I better cancel my plans because who knows how long it's gonna take me to figure this out.
cues.zh: 所以此时你会想，这看起来像是个内存踩踏，我最好取消我的计划，因为谁知道我要花多长时间才能查出来。

cues.en: But
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: what I can do here is bring this play mode variable into my watch window
cues.zh: 我在这里可以做的是把这个播放模式变量加到监视窗口中

cues.en: and I can set a data breakpoint on it.
cues.zh: 然后我可以在它上面设置一个数据断点。

cues.en: And now when I run backwards,
cues.zh: 现在当我向后运行时，

cues.en: I'm gonna find the
cues.zh: 我将找到

cues.en: most recent write that happened into that memory.
cues.zh: 最近对该内存进行的写入操作。

cues.en: And it looks like that was right here. I'm assigning the value one point o to something so that makes sense.
cues.zh: 看起来就是在这里。我正在把 1.0 的值赋给某个东西，这说得通。

cues.en: And if I go back a couple more, it looks like the index I was using to write into this buffer started at 15.
cues.zh: 再往前退几步，可以看到我用来写入缓冲区的索引最初是 15。

cues.en: It incremented to 16 compared to the capacity which is also 16.
cues.zh: 它自增到了 16，而容量也正好是 16。

cues.en: So this should have wrapped around here but it didn't.
cues.zh: 所以这里本来应该回绕的，但并没有。

cues.en: And it looks like this is the bug here. This greater than should have been a greater than or equal to.
cues.zh: 看来 Bug 就在这里：这个大于号本该是大于等于号。

cues.en: So obviously, again, this was a contrived example,
cues.zh: 显然，这又是一个刻意构造的例子，

cues.en: but this isn't a totally unheard of kind of bug, unfortunately.
cues.zh: 但很遗憾，这种 Bug 也并非完全罕见。

cues.en: And you can imagine that if I were attacking this with printfs or something instead, I might be in for kind of a long night.
cues.zh: 你可以想象，如果换成靠打 printf 之类的方式来排查，今晚恐怕就得熬个大长夜了。

cues.en: Luckily though, most bugs aren't even that complicated, they're just run of the mill logic errors in gameplay code or something. So being able to debug those with this kind of system makes it super easy.
cues.zh: 不过幸运的是，大多数 Bug 甚至没这么复杂，无非是游戏逻辑代码里常见的普通错误。能用这样的系统来调试，简直轻而易举。

cues.en: So that brings me to the end of the demo.
cues.zh: 那么本次演示就到这里。

cues.zh: 欢迎查看简介中的链接，获取更多关于 TMR Corporation 的精彩内容。

cues.zh: 感谢观看。
